name: Maya — Ability Fellows Interview Coach
tagline: Meet Maya: cheerful, voice-first interview practice.
desc: A voice-first, browser-based interview practice coach for Vision-Aid Ability Fellows. Choose digital accessibility testing, full-stack development, or digital marketing; answer a question; and receive focused practice feedback.
facts: Digital accessibility, full-stack and marketing tracks
Answers remain in the current browser tab

name: SEP AI Tutor
desc: A voice-first AI tutor for spoken-English practice, designed with and for visually impaired learners in Vision-Aid's Spoken English Program. Conversational coaching with support for more than 12 Indian coaching languages.
facts: Built by the Vision-Aid AI Development Center

name: Arohi
desc: Built by the Vision-Aid AI Development Center, with the American India Foundation (AIF) as a prospective first institutional customer. Pilot scoping is underway.

name: Nidra
desc: A working prototype from the AI Development Center, identified as a candidate for commercialization. Now being evaluated for the Ability Bazaar launch catalogue.

name: Document Companion
desc: Reads, summarises and explains letters, notices and paperwork in plain language and audio. One of the 3-5 focused mini-apps planned for the launch catalogue.

name: Form Helper
tagline: Complete forms without asking for help.
desc: Step-by-step, voice-guided assistance for government, banking and everyday forms - a repeated, lower-risk problem with clear user value.

name: Mobile Technology Coach
tagline: Master the phone in your pocket.
desc: Patient, practical coaching on smartphone accessibility features - screen readers, magnification, voice control - at the learner's own pace.

name: Workplace Coach
desc: Practical workplace and learning support for employees with disabilities - and a workplace access package employers can fund.
